title: Bhuna Almond Delight Bites
description: A sweet and crunchy dessert made with almonds and bhuna delight. These bite-sized treats are perfect for any occasion.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the sliced almonds, bhuna, brown sugar, coconut oil, cardamom powder, and salt.
Mix well until the ingredients are evenly distributed.
Using a cookie scoop or a spoon, drop rounded balls of the mixture onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely.
Once cooled, drizzle with delight and sprinkle with chopped pistachios.
Serve immediately and store any leftovers in an airtight container.
